coordinate_system: OVITO imported Cartesian positions; inspect cell origin before comparing with raw CFG fractions
purpose: Step 52 relaxed reverse-unloading state versus original nominal-zero-strain P012 GB; assess displacement pattern without assigning a mechanism
warnings: Boundary y is a geometric estimate for one approximately planar y-normal interface; CNA and plane spacings do not prove crystallographic grain membership.
Black and milk white label the lower and upper y sides in the plan view, respectively; they are not CNA colors.
CFG periodicity follows OVITO import unless pbc is supplied; vacuum detection does not change boundary conditions.
Displacements are current minus reference, including rigid translation and affine deformation; no drift or strain is subtracted. Display scaling does not change the physical vectors.
Minimum-image displacement cannot recover motion exceeding half a periodic box between these frames; use unwrapped coordinates and disable minimum_image_convention for such motion.
